title: OracleProto: A Reproducible Framework for Benchmarking LLM Forecasting via Knowledge Cutoffs and Temporal Masking
abstract: arXiv:2605.03762v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Forecasting is a composite capability encompassing information gathering, evidence integration, situational assessment, and decision-making. Large language models (LLMs) combine reasoning and tool use, offering new avenues for automated forecasting and decision support. Yet LLM forecasting evaluation faces a structural challenge: live benchmarks support prospective assessment, but limited question reuse and changing information conditions make results difficult to reproduce and compare; retrospective benchmarks offer reproducibility but risk information leakage. translated_title: OracleProto：一个通过知识截止与时间遮蔽实现大语言模型预测可复现基准评测的框架
translated_abstract: 预测是一项综合性能力，涵盖信息收集、证据整合、态势评估与决策制定。大语言模型（LLM）兼具推理与工具使用能力，为自动化预测和决策支持开辟了新途径。然而，LLM预测评估面临一个结构性挑战：实时基准支持前瞻性评估，但问题复用受限且信息条件不断变化，使得结果难以复现和比较；回溯性基准虽具可复现性，却存在信息泄露的风险。我们提出了OracleProto，这是一个在受控、时间遮蔽环境中评估LLM预测能力的可复现框架。通过模型知识截止约束与时间遮蔽机制，OracleProto为真实世界的网络检索构建了时间沙盒，通过泄露检测审计信息边界，并将已有结果的事件重构为预测实例……
tldr: OracleProto通过知识截止约束与时间遮蔽构建“时间沙盒”，解决了LLM预测评估中实时基准难以复现与回溯基准易泄露信息之间的结构性矛盾，实现了可复现且无信息泄露的预测能力评测。
en_tdlr: OracleProto resolves the structural tradeoff between reproducibility and information leakage in LLM forecasting evaluation by building a temporal sandbox with knowledge cutoff constraints and temporal masking, enabling reproducible, leakage-free benchmarking.
